changes: p1 as_written changed from the truncated 'upādhyāya vaṃśīdharā' to the actual compound form 'vaṃśīdharātmaja'
p3 (scribe) confidence lowered from high to medium because the name is corrupt ('radhunaṃdane'), although the catalogue's 'Raghunandana' supports the reading

notes: The quoted colophon has no date. The catalogue gives ŚS 1754 (≈1832 CE), which probably comes from another part of the manuscript; it is not recorded here. The scribe's name 'radhunaṃdane' is a corruption of Raghunandana, and the locative 'radhunaṃdane' after 'likhitaṃ' is used where an instrumental would be expected. 'upādhyāya' attaches to the author's father, Vaṃśīdhara, not to Vidyāpati. 'vaidyarahasyābhidhoyoga samupaset (!)' is corrupt, probably meaning something like '°abhidho yogaḥ samāptaḥ' ('the work called Vaidyarahasya is finished').
